about_short_description.short_description: Microsystem Hotspot is a web platform that provides monetization and Wi-Fi management solutions.

product.name: Wi-Fi Marketing and Monetization
product.description: A platform that uses Wi-Fi networks to engage with visitors through SMS, app push, email, and captive portal pages, capturing detailed data for marketing purposes.

product.name: Internet Management Cloud System
product.description: A cloud-based system for managing internet bandwidth, speed, and quotas, with features like load balancing, firewall security, and remote management.

product.name: Carrier and Service Provider WiFi
product.description: A scalable platform for MNOs and ISPs to offer white-labeled guest WiFi solutions, integrating with existing products and enabling network expansion.

product.name: WiFi for Commercial Offices
product.description: A solution providing secure guest WiFi in commercial buildings, enhancing visitor engagement and offering content filtering services.

product.name: WiFi for Hotels
product.description: A WiFi solution for hotels to capture guest data, drive targeted marketing campaigns, and offer both free and paid internet access.

product.name: WiFi for Restaurants and Cafes
product.description: A service offering free WiFi in dining venues, enabling customer engagement through promotions and social media integration.
